description:
Check text against the sources it cites, paragraph by paragraph, with Jev (the same check Zearch runs on its own answers). Cite sources inline as [1], [2]… in the order you list them. Use it to gate output from your own model before a person sees it.

Limits: text up to 8,000 characters; 1 to 8 sources of up to 20,000 characters each. Costs 1 credit, charged only when the check completes. Returns pass/fail per paragraph with support and attribution probabilities.

question.description: The question the text answers, if any. Improves the check.

sources.description: Sources in citation order: the first is [1].

text.description: The source text the citations refer to.
Markdown to check. Every paragraph should cite at least one source as [n].

name: verify

attribution.description: Probability that the citation points at the right source.

support.description: Probability, 0 to 1, that the cited sources support this paragraph.

passed.description: True when every paragraph met the support threshold.

title: Verify text against sources
